comparison.objective: Tension and snap a chalk line to leave a straight mark; candidate breaks insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual line tension and vertical pluck-release versus rigid mandrel holding and hammer-delivered fracture impulse.
comparison.success_condition: One straight print within mark/bow tolerances versus four separated tangs, intact inserts, and physical recovery.
comparison.reason: Both include a transient impact, but the tested abilities and material outcomes are meaningfully different.
